svg.title: PipeANN with post-filtering and NemoANN search the same graph with a label filter
svg.text: How does NemoANN avoid wasted SSD reads?
Both systems search the same graph index on SSD for the nearest nodes that carry the query's label.
One node in ten carries it. Each panel is one of 32 search threads, running at its measured speed.
reads every node it visits from the SSD, then drops the ones without the label
checks the label in memory first and tunnels through the other nodes
Measured: BigANN-100M, 10% selectivity, 90% Recall@10, 32 search threads. PipeANN answers 2.1K queries/s and NemoANN 16.9K.
SSD reads per query: about 206 for PipeANN and 25 for NemoANN. PipeANN-Filter, which densifies the index, answers 3.4K queries/s.
Illustration: the graph is a toy. A thread spends 32 / throughput on each query, 15.2 ms with PipeANN and 1.9 ms with NemoANN.
